Online Multiplayer
• Play online-compatible Nintendo DS games with friends around the world!
• Connect via community Nintendo WFC servers

apps.localizedDescription:
Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, and N64.

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• And plenty more to come!

Controller Support
• Supports PS4, PS5, Xbox One S, Xbox Series X, and MFi game controllers.
• Supports bluetooth (and wired) keyboards, as well as the Apple Smart Keyboard.
• Completely customize button mappings on a per-system, per-controller basis.
• Map buttons to special “Quick Save”, “Quick Load,” and “Fast Forward” actions.

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay

Delta Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (ex: run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

**Delta and AltStore LLC are in no way affiliated with Nintendo. The name "Nintendo" and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd.**

versions.localizedDescription:
NEW

DLC
• Custom in-game experiences for Pokémon games, built by our team
• Unlock event items, receive rare Pokémon, and more
• Start an event from the Pause Menu while playing
• First event available now for Pokémon Emerald!

Custom Filters
• New Experimental Feature for using custom game screen filters
• Includes two presets for every system, such as CRT and original Game Boy
• Import your own filters from the Files app

IMPROVED
• Dynamically updates “Audio” settings icon to reflect current volume level
• Open files browser directly upon tapping "+" button
• Change fast forward speed via per-game settings
• Restored the “Choose” button when no Nintendo WFC server is selected
• Updated larger devices to show three games on game selection screen
• Renamed “Minor Settings” to “Lil’ Settings”
• Updated the previous sync status screen for iOS 26
• Removed the redundant RetroAchievements heading from per-game settings
• Limited the number of games shown in Recents
• Updated the RetroAchievements description in per-game settings

FIXED
• Fixed fast forward and load state buttons disappearing when RetroAchievements are enabled
• Fixed settings icons showing incorrect colors in light and dark mode
• Fixed controller input picker appearing blue instead of purple on iOS 26
• Fixed animated controller skins missing buttons in skin selection screen
• Fixed importing .md files for Sega Genesis games
• Fixed screenshot notifications appearing behind the pause menu
• Fixed online multiplayer help text appearing when a Nintendo WFC server is already selected
• Fixed RetroAchievements achievement notifications sometimes not appearing
• Fixed crash when resizing Pause Menu to very small sizes
• Fixed not disabling hardcore mode for games
• Fixed app hanging indefinitely when showing cheats

NEW

Custom Fast Forward
• Change the preferred Fast Forward speed per-system and per-game
• Long-press the Fast Forward button from the Pause Menu to adjust speed

Animated Controller Skins
• Adds support for controller skins with animated buttons
• New, official animated GBA skin by Caroline Moore

Audio Settings
• New audio settings to determine how Delta handles other apps' audio
• "Mix with Other Audio" keeps your music or podcasts playing during games
• "Pause Other Audio" silences everything else when a game starts

Adjustable Screen Position
• Long-press the game screen to adjust its position when a controller is connected

IMPROVED
• Graduated RetroAchievements from Experimental Features
• Moved Online Multiplayer from Nintendo DS Core settings to top-level settings
• Added option to move Home and Resume buttons to top of Pause Menu
• Redesigned controller input mapping screen for game controllers and keyboards
• Added the ability to delete save states in bulk
• Automatically sync favorites between devices

FIXED
• Fixed error when loading RetroAchievements account information

NEW

Redesigned Settings
• Reorganizes settings into more easily navigable hierarchy
• Icons help differentiate top-level settings
• Access all settings options more quickly and intuitively

Epilogue GB/SN Operator Support (thanks Epilogue!)
• Connect game cartridges directly to your iPhone/iPad and play them natively
• Reads and writes save files to cartridge
• Supports GBC/GBA and SNES games (respectively)
• Blowing into cartridges optional

Cheats
• Fully redesigned cheats screen for Liquid Glass
• Choose icons from a wide selection for added personalization

IMPROVED
• Removed “Import from iTunes” game import option
• Changed “Open Games in New Window” setting to be off by default

FIXED
• Fixed SNES audio crackling
• Fixed NES games occasionally opening to a black screen

versions.localizedDescription:
iPad Support
• Optimized for larger iPad display
• Supports multiple windows

3rd-Party Keyboard
• Easily paste clippings into any text field
• Switches back to default keyboard automatically after pasting

• Switches to using location services to run in background
• Improves reading clipboard on iOS 17

apps.localizedDescription:
Clip is a simple clipboard manager for iOS. 

Unlike other clipboard managers, Clip can continue monitoring your clipboard while in the background. No longer do you need to remember to manually open or share to an app to save your clipboard; just copy and paste as you would normally do, and Clip will have your back.

In addition to background monitoring, Clip also has these features:

• Save text, URLs, and images copied to the clipboard.
• Copy, delete, or share any clippings saved to Clip.
• Customizable history limit.

Download Clip today, and never worry about losing your clipboard again!

NEW

iPad Support
• Supports multiple windows
• Supports resizing windows in Stage Manager

FIXED

Custom Keyboard
• Fixed invisible text in dark mode
• Fixed opaque background in dark mode
• Fixed opening keyboard settings

• Switches to using location services to run in background
• Improves reading clipboard on iOS 17

This update adds a Custom Keyboard app extension for quick access to clippings when editing text.

To enable the keyboard, go to Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard... and add "ClipBoard". Once added, make sure to then enable "Allow Full Access" for ClipBoard so it can access your clippings.
